title: Spot and the Frog
cover: Spot the dalmatian. Big, simple and friendly.

pages.beat: Spot looking at one big round spot on her leg.
A green frog on a lily pad, Spot surprised.

pages.text: The frog is in the pond.
pages.beat: A small pond, frog's head above the water, Spot at the edge.
Spot soaked and dripping after jumping in.
Tip curled in an empty bird's nest on a low branch.

pages.text: Milk! Tip ran to the milk.
pages.beat: Tip running to a saucer of milk.
Mim perched on top of a lampshade.
Spot digging in a sandpit, sand flying.

pages.text: Spot has a spot. She is in the pond. Drip, drip.
Nap, Spot. Nap in the sand.
pages.beat: Spot asleep in the sand, the frog asleep on a rock.
